name: agent-workflow-kit
description: A team workflow for coding agents: short project memory, rules, safe-change and self-review checklists, manager/worker orchestration with a state owner, agent-to-agent messaging, hand-off and resume, bug intake, team hand-off messages, cloud ops, and safety hooks.

preset.title: Edition: auto, lite, low-tokens, normal or best
preset.description: auto = the kit sizes each task and decides. lite = safety net only, least overhead. low-tokens = cheapest sessions, short replies, no sub-agents unless needed. normal = balanced (default). best = strictest: strict hooks, a test run and a test file before done, independent review of risky code, uses more tokens.

hooks_enabled.title: Enable safety hooks
hooks_enabled.description: Run the kit's commit, secret, protected-file and database guards. Turn off to keep only the skills.

block_ai_trailers.title: Block AI attribution trailers
block_ai_trailers.description: Refuse git commits whose message has a Co-Authored-By trailer or a 'Generated with' line.

secret_scan.title: Scan for secrets
secret_scan.description: Scan staged changes before git commit, and file content before writes, for clear credential patterns.

destructive_db_guard.title: Block destructive database commands
destructive_db_guard.description: Refuse commands such as migrate reset, db push, DROP, TRUNCATE and DELETE without WHERE.

reply_style.title: Reply style
reply_style.description: Personal reply style: auto (follow the edition), normal, caveman-lite or caveman-full.

profile.title: Hook profile
profile.description: auto (follow the edition), minimal (only clear safety nets), standard or strict (warnings and soft asks become stops).
